settings.title: Drain watch: tell the phone when a plan moves much faster than usual for the same work
Ask near the limit: before a task would take a usage window past this percent, ask first (automations wait for the reset)
Check Codex & Antigravity while waiting: read their usage every 10 minutes while work waits for a plan (spends nothing)
Stop a run silent for: stop a run with no output for this many hours (a run silent 30 minutes while its plan moves is always told to your phone)
Spare allowance: say on home when a weekly window resets within a day with a fifth or more left
Window notices: say when a usage window changed length or resets early
